name: Skimmer des marais
lore: Nom seul dans la source : silhouette et construction proposées pour le jeu, sans validation canonique ni statistiques inventées.

assets.label: Skimmer des marais — proposition de châssis
assets.prompt: Design an original modular vehicle for the 2D Yautja fan-game La Longue Chasse from its NAME-ONLY brief. This is an explicit new design proposal, not a reconstruction of an existing canonical film vehicle. Exactly TWO full side-profile views SIDE BY SIDE: left craft points RIGHT, right craft LEFT; identical construction and scale, separately drawn opposite sides. Full silhouette within each half, wide margins. Pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Detailed painted game bitmap, dark alien bronze/gunmetal hardware with subtle small status lamps. NO scenery, ground shadow, text, layout labels, rider, passenger, cargo, trophy or effects. Empty hardware sockets for detachable modules, no baked-in weapons. A low compact amphibious swamp skimmer with broad shallow hull, two swept-outside sealed buoyant pontoons, ventral antigravity grilles protected from mud by lattice covers, raised single empty operator saddle well, wide front impact bar, two low enclosed rear fan ducts with removable protective mesh. Weathered moss-green dark metal with a few mud stains but NO actual vegetation. Clear side profile distinct from a desert hover-bike, no propeller protruding dangerously into rider position.
notes: Le nom est demandé ; les choix mécaniques sont des propositions originales à valider.
Deux vues statiques en revue, aucun clip runtime. Pilote, armes et effets doivent rester indépendants.
